raw_segments.text: Clytemnestra. Oh ye just men who speak my sentence now, the city's hate, the ban of
all my realm. Ye had no voice of old to launch such doom on him, my husband, when he held
as light my daughter's life as that of sheep or goat, one victim from the thronging fleecy
fold. Ye slew and sacrifice his child and mine, the well-loved issue of my travail pangs,
to lull and lay the gales that blew from Thrace.
That deed of his, I say, that stain and shame, had rightly been atoned by banishment. But
ye, who then were dumb, are stern to judge this deed of mine that doth affront your ears.
Storm out your threats, yet knowing this for sooth, that I am ready, if your hand prevail
as mine now doth, to bow beneath your sway. If God say nay, it shall be yours to learn
